note: Both define merchant-hosted agent checkout sessions; five status names match and both publish well-known discovery documents, but no bridge or mapping exists. Stripe co-maintains ACP and documents UCP for sellers who run their own checkout (its hub paired UCP or ACP until at least 2026-10-12).
Stripe co-maintains ACP and co-authors MPP with Tempo; MPP accepts cards through the same Shared Payment Token family that implements ACP Delegate Payment.
Visa Intelligent Commerce tokens under SPTs: Stripe says it might use them for SPT card payments, so Visa agent tokens can sit under an ACP payment. TAP itself has no documented link to ACP.
No documented protocol link. Stripe says it might use Mastercard Agent Pay tokens under SPT card payments.
ACP has no mandates or signed user intent; AP2 mandates or Verifiable Intent could add that layer, but no adopted extension exists.
